title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Income support for eligible farmer families to help with cultivation, household expenditure and agricultural needs.
targetFarmers: Eligible farmer families with valid landholding records and active beneficiary status.
benefits: Direct income support to eligible farmer families
Support for farmer household income and stability
eligibility: Eligible farmer families must meet the current PM-KISAN conditions notified by the Government of India.
Applicant status is subject to land records and official verification.
Use the official portal for current eligibility and beneficiary guidance.
documents: Bank account details linked to the beneficiary
Landholding and farmer family information as per government records
applicationSteps: Check eligibility and beneficiary information on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Complete or update e-KYC if required through the official process.
Confirm bank account details and beneficiary information.
Use the official portal to check live beneficiary and payment status.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Agricultural credit facility for eligible cultivators and farmer groups to support crop cultivation, working capital and related farm requirements through participating banks.
targetFarmers: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and eligible SHG/JLG farmer groups, subject to the current official listing and lender rules.
benefits: Working capital support for cultivation and seasonal expenses
Credit facility through participating banks under applicable rules
eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and eligible SHG/JLG farmer groups may generally apply under the current official listing.
Loan limits, interest terms and sanction depend on eligibility, bank policy and applicable rules.
Loan amount, interest terms and sanction are subject to lender assessment and eligibility.
documents: Certified landholding or cultivation proof as required
Other documents requested by the participating bank
applicationSteps: Review the current KCC information on the official MyScheme listing.
Prepare the documents requested by the participating bank.
Apply online or offline through a participating bank or designated channel.
Complete bank verification and assessment before accepting any terms.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme designed to provide financial protection to farmers against crop losses due to insured events and specified natural uncertainties.
targetFarmers: Farmers growing notified crops in participating areas and enrolled under the scheme.
benefits: Insurance protection against notified crop losses
Support during adverse weather and crop damage events
Official claim, status and grievance channels
eligibility: Coverage depends on the notified crop, season and applicable area rules.
Premium and enrollment conditions are set under official scheme guidelines.
Coverage and claim settlement are subject to the implementing authority and official policy rules.
documents: Proof of crop loss or claim documentation as required
applicationSteps: Check crop, area and season eligibility on the official PMFBY portal.
Use the official portal for enrollment, premium and application information.
Keep records of crop sowing, losses and related farm information.
Use official status, loss reporting and grievance channels when required.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Public investment support for agricultural infrastructure and related rural farm logistics under official government guidance.
targetFarmers: Farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives and agricultural entities implementing eligible infrastructure projects.
benefits: Potential support for farm-linked facilities and services
Strengthening storage, logistics and post-harvest systems
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the official project and institutional framework.
Project approval and sanction are subject to official government rules and qualifying conditions.
Please verify current eligibility and financial terms on the official government source.
documents: Identity and institutional documents as required
Land, usage and compliance information as applicable
Supporting details for implementation and financing
applicationSteps: Review official AIF guidance and qualifying project categories.
Prepare the required project and institutional documentation.
Apply through the designated official process.
Track approval and implementation through official channels.
